title: Material stocktaking
subtitle: Count raw materials with a scanner or manually.
unavailable: The material list could not be loaded.
shift_required: Start your shift to perform stocktaking.
scanner_help: Scan the package code. Focus remains in the field after every scan.
scanner_warning: Saving replaces material stock with this complete scan. Unscanned materials will be set to 0.
manual_help: Values are in the material base units. Filters only hide rows — saving includes the full list.
manual_warning: Saving replaces stock for all materials. A material with 0 is cleared.
confirm_save: Save the complete stocktaking? This updates material stock.
manual_incomplete: The material list changed. Refresh before saving.
failed: Stocktaking could not be saved. Please try again.
